inbox.section_description: Recent activity across your projects, scans, and approvals.

scan_scheduled_completed.title: Scheduled scan completed: {{project_name}}
scan_scheduled_completed.body: The scheduled scan finished. Review the results when you have a moment.

scan_scheduled_failed.title: Scheduled scan failed: {{project_name}}
scan_scheduled_failed.body: The scheduled scan did not complete.

scan_scheduled_failed_detail.title: Scheduled scan failed: {{project_name}}
scan_scheduled_failed_detail.body: The scheduled scan did not complete. Error: {{error}}

vuln_sla_breach.title: SLA breach in {{project_name}}: {{count}} overdue
vuln_sla_breach.body: Open findings that crossed the remediation SLA since {{since}}: {{count}} ({{breakdown}}). Review the overdue list and triage or remediate.

malicious_in_project.title: Known-malicious package in {{project_name}}
malicious_in_project.body: {{purl}} is listed as malicious by a newly published advisory. Remove it and rotate the credentials this build could reach. Upgrading does not help.

malicious_in_project_advisory.title: Known-malicious package in {{project_name}}
malicious_in_project_advisory.body: {{purl}} is listed as malicious by a newly published advisory ({{advisory_id}}). Remove it and rotate the credentials this build could reach. Upgrading does not help.

anonymisation_request_expired.title: Anonymization request expired
anonymisation_request_expired.body: The anonymization request for user {{subject_user_id}} expired unapproved on {{expires_on}}. It can no longer be approved. Open a new request if the erasure is still needed.

mfa_enabled.title: Two-step sign-in is now on
mfa_enabled.body: An authenticator app was set up on your account. If that was not you, change your password and tell your administrator: whoever did it can sign in as you.

mfa_recovery_codes_regenerated.title: New recovery codes were issued
mfa_recovery_codes_regenerated.body: A fresh set of recovery codes was created for your account and the previous set no longer works. If that was not you, change your password and tell your administrator.

mfa_cleared_by_admin.title: Your second factor was removed
mfa_cleared_by_admin.body: An administrator cleared the authenticator app on your account. If you did not ask for this, tell your administrator and set up two-factor sign-in again straight away.

cve_detected.title: New CVE found in {{component}}
cve_detected.body: {{cve_id}} affects {{component}}. Open the project to triage it.

license_violation.title: Forbidden license found
license_violation.body: {{license_id}} was found in {{component}}. Review it before the next release.

policy_gate_failed.title: Build gate blocked a build
policy_gate_failed.body: The build gate blocked {{project_name}}: a forbidden license or a critical vulnerability was found.

approval_pending.title: Component approval waiting
approval_pending.body: A component approval request is waiting for your review.

email.description: Send a digest to your registered email address.

slack.description: Post to the Slack webhook configured for your organization.

teams.description: Post to the Microsoft Teams webhook configured for your organization.

in_app.label: In-app
in_app.description: Show notifications in the bell menu and the inbox below.
